title: Raku Firing Workshop
evidence_quote: Arrive with up to four bisqued pieces ready to glaze and fire using traditional Raku techniques!
evidence_sentence: Bring up to four bisque-fired pieces, glaze them with raku glazes and watch them fired the same day.
summary: Bring up to four bisque-fired pieces, glaze them and watch the raku firing; you leave with finished pottery the same day. Bring snacks (zero proof only).
how_to_join: Pick a date and book on the booking page
